system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Even when all seems lost, and there doesn’t seem to be any more hope. You and your clans presence is more than enough to instill the thought that there is a way forward. Creatures of your choice that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, reduce ranks of Demoralized and Shaken they have by -1.
